changes.reason: WP7: The old reason mentioned "up to 1.5%" HP Pay Happy Coins (a different currency), which tripped the loader's "up to" multi-rate check. Savings Maximiser: max Rs12,000 spend and 2,400 points per cycle = a fixed 30 per Rs150.

WP7: D28c: Savings Maximiser: 3X "Applicable on: All other retail spends excluding Insurance premium payments, non-HPCL fuel spends, EMI transactions, ATM cash withdrawals". The record's EMI row needs category emi AND rail emi, so an EMI purchase in another category earned. Rail-EMI exclusion on all spend.

card-data group4: D14b. The rule is restricted to direct (non-aggregator) education payments; that channel is not in the C3.1 context. Its rate (3 per Rs150) equals the other-retail base, which governs; the Savings Maximiser gives 3X on "All other retail spends" and names no education exclusion.

action.reason: Fuel paid by UPI earns no reward points.

changes.reason: card-data group4: HPCL fuel 30X: "Not Applicable on UPI transactions"; Savings Maximiser, UPI Rewards: "Exclusions: Insurance premium payments, fuel spends, EMI transactions, ATM cash withdrawals, utility spends, grocery spends and IDFC FIRST FASTag recharges." The 30X HPCL rule had no rail, so HPCL fuel by UPI QR earned 30X (over-statement). Rail-scoped (D25b). Category-scoped with the MCC list (D20a rows), so a UPI spend in this category with no MCC (typical SMS) is caught in v2 (H2, lead ruling 2026-11-06). The loader's v1 row cannot see the rail, so v1 excludes the whole category on an unknown rail: installed apps under-state (accepted; fresh-start release).
